summary: Configured a nightly 02:17 backup from node2 to node1. Dated, root-only archives are stored in /var/backups/inventory and archives older than 7 days are removed. Both nodes retain Ubuntu 16.04.7 and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic. The source directory was initially absent, so it was created; it is currently empty.
actions_performed: Generated a dedicated Ed25519 key on node1 and restricted it on node2 to the backup tar command from node1 only.
Verified live transfer integrity with a temporary probe, then removed the probe and rebuilt a clean archive.
Confirmed retention deletes an 8-day archive while preserving a 6-day archive.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Nightly dated backups from node2 to node1
evidence.summary: Shows the 02:17 cron schedule, successful checksum-verified transfer, dated root-only archive, and successful final end-to-end backup after both restarts.
Direct test shows an 8-day archive deleted and a 6-day archive retained.
Shows node-generated key fingerprint, source-IP and command-restricted authorization, and matching node2 host-key fingerprint.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Post-restart output confirms Ubuntu 16.04.7 and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic on both nodes.
Captures healthy baseline boot ID 0256e3f5…, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 54ac8a73…, active cron, persisted schedule, successful backup, and valid archive.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID ac73b359…, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 62c1bbc5…, recovered SSH listener, persisted source and authorization, and a successful node1-to-node2 backup afterward.
